author: Patrick Tomasso
description:
#movies #cinematography 

I sat down with Ridley Scott to talk about cinematography, storyboarding, working with multiple cameras, collaborating with cinematographers like Erik Messerschmidt, and how his generation of commercial directors helped change the way movies are shot and edited.

Ridley also talks about making his first film with his brother Tony Scott, his approach to filmmaking after decades behind the camera, and why sometimes it really does just come down to having a good eye.
title: Ridley Scott talks about cinematography
